messages.subject: Shiny Server - Reading files
parts:
Hi, I have a strange problem where loading datasets within a shiny app does work without any flaws when running the app from within rstudio, but it fails everytime via shiny-server.

I get the same error message every time:

Warning: Error in eval: Cannot read file /srv/shiny-server/pegida/pegida_facebook_merged_Dec14-Apr16.csv
Stack trace (innermost first):
    48: <Anonymous>
    47: stop
    46: guess_header_
    45: guess_header
    44: col_spec_standardise
    43: read_delimited
    42: read_delim
    41: eval
    40: eval
    39: withVisible
    38: source
     1: runApp
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : 
  Cannot read file /srv/shiny-server/pegida/pegida_facebook_merged_Dec14-Apr16.csv

shiny-server.js:268 Sat May 28 2016 12:59:28 GMT+0200 (CEST): Connection closed. Info: 

I alread tried absolute and relative paths without success. The system is ubunti und shiny-server is updated to the latest version.

Do you have an idea whats going on here?  Does shiny-server have some kind of memory cap which forbids reading in large files?

Cheers,
Carsten
